rows.name: Citizens Advisory Board — Regional Institute for Children & Adolescents
rows.mandate: Advises the Regional Institute for Children & Adolescents on programming, governance, and quality standards for youth with behavioral health needs in Maryland.

rows.name: Advisory Board — Developmental Disabilities Administration
rows.mandate: Advises Maryland's Developmental Disabilities Administration on policy, programs, and services for Marylanders with developmental disabilities.

rows.name: Maryland Commission for Women
rows.mandate: Advises the Governor and General Assembly on issues affecting Maryland women and girls. Conducts research, makes policy recommendations, and monitors gender equity across state programs.

rows.name: State Interagency Council on Homelessness
rows.mandate: Coordinates state strategy on homelessness. Oversees federal McKinney-Vento funding, data systems (HMIS), and cross-agency program alignment.

rows.name: Maryland Commission on African American History & Culture
rows.mandate: Advises on the preservation of African American history and culture in Maryland. Reviews policy, distributes grants, and advocates for heritage recognition statewide.

rows.name: Opioid Response Advisory Council
rows.mandate: Advises the Governor on Maryland's opioid and substance use disorder response strategy. Oversees grant-funded programs, interagency coordination, and data-informed intervention models.

rows.name: Commission on Public Health — Data & IT Workgroup
rows.mandate: Modernizes Maryland's public health data infrastructure. Oversees statewide health data reporting systems, IT governance, and digital transformation of public health programs.

rows.name: Environmental Justice Advisory Committee
rows.mandate: Advises the Secretary of the Environment on environmental justice policy, permit reviews, and equitable distribution of environmental benefits and burdens across Maryland communities.

rows.name: Maryland Health Care Commission
rows.mandate: Regulates health care facilities, produces statewide health data analytics, oversees Maryland's all-payer model, and guides health information exchange policy and interoperability.

rows.name: Maryland State Board of Education
rows.mandate: Sets K-12 education policy for Maryland public schools. Establishes academic standards, accountability frameworks, and guides education technology, equity, and workforce pipeline initiatives.

rows.name: Maryland Hispanic Affairs Commission
rows.mandate: Advises the Governor on programs and policies for Maryland's Hispanic and Latino community. Makes recommendations on language access, economic equity, education, and health services.

rows.name: Criminal Justice Information Advisory Board
rows.mandate: Oversees Maryland's criminal justice data infrastructure, interoperability standards, and privacy policy for statewide information sharing systems.

rows.name: Affordable Housing Trust Fund Committee
rows.mandate: Oversees Maryland's affordable housing grant programs. Reviews applications, sets funding priorities, and ensures programmatic compliance with federal requirements.

rows.name: Governor's AI Subcabinet Advisory Pathway
rows.mandate: Advises Maryland's AI Governance initiative under the AI Governance Act (2024). Shapes state AI policy, enterprise AI adoption standards, and responsible AI frameworks across all state agencies.

rows.name: Governor's Commission on Education Excellence
rows.mandate: Advises on K-12 education strategy, workforce pipeline, and technology-enabled learning initiatives for Maryland students.
